laws.rule: Ordesa y Monte Perdido National Park (Huesca): lighting fires is prohibited. Free camping is prohibited, and since 9 February 2022 overnight bivouac or camping is prohibited across the whole Ordesa sector; the only exception is the Góriz campsite, which has limited places and needs a booking through the Góriz refuge. In the other sectors overnight bivouac is allowed only above set altitudes: 2,550 m in Pineta, 1,800 m in Escuaín (La Ralla) and 1,650 m in Añisclo (Fuenblanca); stays are capped at three nights per sector, and tents go up from one hour before sunset to one hour after sunrise. Bicycles are prohibited on restricted paths.

laws.rule: In the same park, loose dogs are prohibited; swimming in rivers and mountain lakes (ibones) is prohibited; collecting animals, plants, minerals or rocks is prohibited; hunting and fishing are prohibited. The page lists no fine amounts.
